title: EOD SUPPORT SERVICES TYNDALL AFB - RFI
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.AIR COMBAT COMMAND.FA4819  325 CONS PKP
detail_text: This is not a solicitation for offers. This is a request for information to gain feedback from the market. All information given is completely voluntary. We are requesting you review the attached Performance Work Statement and provide feedback on the document, scope, resume requirements, etc. The USAF and 325 CONS is dedicated to fostering competition in procurement, and values industry expertise (RFO 10.001(c)) to assist us in doing so. Provided below is a brief description of the requirement. More information is available within the PWS.GENERAL INFORMATION: The 325th Contracting Squadron, Tyndall AFB, Florida, in support of the 801st Red Horse Training Squadron (801 RHTS) is conducting a Non-Personal Services acquisition for Explosive Ordinance Disposal (EOD) Flight Support Technicians. Requirements under this acquisition will include including scheduling and setup for EOD training courses, to include joint service/multinational events, and Combat Support Training Range (CSTR) events, training documentation, maintenance of EOD tools and equipment, maintenance of EOD munitions accounts, equipment and munitions documentation, drafting plans and procedures, reviewing EOD technical reports and making recommendations to management, running unit ?checklist?, and ground and explosive safety requirements. Place of performance for the 801 RHTS EOD Flight Support Technicians acquisition will be at Tyndall AFB, Florida. This acquisition utilizes the RFO (Revolutionary Far Overhaul) and related agency deviations, in lieu of the current FAC (Federal Acquisition Circular).Please send all correspondence to the listed POC. The projected award date is no later than September 30, 2026.
